COGAT continues to maintain close coordination with international actors to monitor the chickenpox situation in the Gaza Strip. A continuous assessment of the situation is being conducted by the relevant international organizations, alongside ongoing joint monitoring and coordination between COGAT and humanitarian partners. At this stage, the United Nations does not intend to conduct a dedicated vaccination campaign against chickenpox, as the disease is generally not considered life-threatening, and vaccination campaigns are not typically used as the primary response measure for such cases. At the same time, COGAT continues to work closely with the UN and additional humanitarian organizations to strengthen water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH) components throughout the Gaza Strip — efforts that play an important role in reducing health risks and supporting the prevention of disease transmission. COGAT continues to work with all relevant humanitarian actors to support an appropriate response to the situation. Should additional requests be submitted for the entry of medical supplies or other necessary equipment related to this matter, COGAT will be prepared to review such requests and work with relevant partners to identify practical solutions.

The Police Sports Association concluded the ninth edition of the Police Jiu-Jitsu Championship, held at the Fatima Bint Mubarak Ladies Sports Academy in Abu Dhabi, with the participation of sectors and departments of the Ministry of Interior and the police general headquarters across the UAE. Abu Dhabi Police claimed first place in the Men’s White and Blue Belt category, followed by Dubai Police in second and Sharjah Police in third. Abu Dhabi Police also secured first place in both the Men’s and Women’s Open Weight divisions, while Dubai Police finished second and the Ministry of Interior team placed third in both categories. The meeting discussed several items on its agenda, including the development of passport services, enhancing their quality, and strengthening integration and coordination among member states.
